profile.name: Akhil Kumar
profile.title: Lead Product Designer · UI/UX & CX
profile.blurb: Designing complex digital products, customer experiences, e-commerce platforms, enterprise systems and AI-powered experiences.

about.lead: I design complex digital products and customer experiences that turn business problems into simple, scalable, and high-performing experiences.
paragraphs: With 16+ years across UI/UX, Product Design, CX and Front-End Development, I lead end-to-end product experiences across e-commerce, retail, marketplaces, mobile apps and enterprise platforms.
My strength is connecting UX, CX and technology: from customer journeys, information architecture and user flows to design systems, prototyping and production.
I start with the customer and business problem, not the interface. I simplify complex workflows and translate user needs and business goals into intuitive, scalable experiences.

Where AI genuinely helps customers, as with conversational search, recommendations and product visualisation, I design it as a product experience. I also use AI tools in my own process for research, ideation and prototyping.
delivers: UX strategy, user research, customer journey mapping, information architecture, user flows, interaction design, usability testing and conversion optimization
E-commerce, marketplaces, PIM, OMS, catalog, seller platforms, customer portals, checkout, promotions, loyalty and growth experiences
Scalable components, design tokens, responsive patterns, accessibility (WCAG) and multi-platform consistency
Conversational interfaces, intelligent search, recommendations, personalization and generative product visualisation
React, Next.js and React Native, enabling strong collaboration with engineering teams

process.title: Research & Discovery
process.body: Start with the business goal and the user. Stakeholder interviews, competitive teardown, analytics, and AI-assisted synthesis to find where the real friction is.

process.title: Define & Map
process.body: Turn findings into clarity — personas, jobs-to-be-done, and end-to-end customer journeys that align product, CX, and engineering on what to build and why.

process.title: Design & Systemize
process.body: Wireframes to high-fidelity flows in Figma, built on a scalable design system so patterns stay consistent, accessible, and fast to ship across web and mobile.

process.title: Prototype & Validate
process.body: Interactive prototypes and usability testing to de-risk decisions early. AI-powered ideation to explore more directions in less time.

process.title: Build & Handoff
process.body: Hands-on front-end in React, Next.js, and React Native — I bridge design and code, so quality holds from concept through production with a clean handoff.
